newsitem.title: USA: Stallone married in London, publicist confirms.
newsitem.headline: Stallone married in London, publicist confirms.

text.p: Movie star Sylvester Stallone married Jennifer Flavin, his long-time girlfriend and the mother of his daughter, in a private ceremony in London, his publicist said on Monday.
Confirming weekend news reports from Britain, Stallone's publicist, Paul Bloch, said the wedding took place on Saturday.
He said in a statement that the civil ceremony, at a private location, was followed by a blessing service at Blenheim Palace, the birthplace of Sir Winston Churchill.

The blessing at the 18th-century country house near Oxford was performed by the Rev. Roger Humphreys, with music by the Christ Church cathedral choir, he said. Next came a "lavish" reception, he added.
At the service, Humphreys also blessed the couple's 8-month-old daughter, Sophia Rose, who recently underwent surgery to repair a heart defect, the statement said.

"I have had two great things happen to me in the past year, the birth of our beautiful daughter, Sophia Rose, and now my marriage to Jennifer, who is a great mother and I know will be a wonderful wife," Stallone was quoted as saying.
Some media reports on Saturday said the wedding took place on the rooftop of London's Dorchester Hotel.

But Stallone left the hotel alone. Although he waved to fans and photographers outside and thrust a fist into the air, the "Rocky" and "Rambo" star simply rubbed his chin quizzically when asked if the couple had wed.
Stallone, 50, and his third wife, a former model who is 28, are on honeymoon in an undisclosed European location, Bloch said.
Stallone's first marriage, to Sasha Czach, ended in 1985 after 13 years. In 1986 Stallone married actress Brigitte Nielsen. They were divorced two years later.
